div.div: When a request arrives, who takes the first step?
The buyer gets quotes from three suppliers.
Senku runs the interview, one block at a time.
"regras": ["Acima de R$ 5 mil, o gerente aprova"]
Who approves when the manager is on leave?
How long does a request wait before quoting?
answered: on leave, the director approves
Everything you say goes into the process charter.
What is missing becomes a question, most important first.
business days, from request to delivery
Tokens run down every path: nothing deadlocks, everything ends.
And 4,000 simulated cases give the real lead time, not just the average.
RACI matrix · from the process map
The flowchart and the full process map come from the same file.
The owner signs off. The TO-BE is born compared with the AS-IS.
